instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Clean the noise out of a recording on my own computer with what it can afford, and tell me where the speech is", and give it file (The recording's name or identity in the person's files).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:enhance-speech and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads a recording from the person's files (`file`) through the run's door, picks the most expensive noise-removal tier within the CPU budget whose ffmpeg filters (and model file, in the models folder the person granted) exist here (light, near-voice, neural), writes the cleaned sound beside it (`<name>.clean.wav`, or `output`), and answers the speech places found by a silence-detect pass, in seconds of the original.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (find_file, read_file, write_file_start, write_file_piece, write_file_finish).
